title: Bar duration mismatch (under- and overfull)
description: Schema-valid two-voice document whose bars don't add up. Bar 1: each voice underfills 4/4 by a different amount (voice 1: half + quarter + eighth = 3.5 beats; voice 2: half + quarter = 3 beats) — two red markers, one per voice. Bar 2: voice 1 overfills (half + half + eighth = 4.5 beats) while voice 2 is exactly right (whole = 4) — one marker only. Exercises the semantic validator: per-voice beat arithmetic in each tooltip, correct voices stay silent, and the notes still draw.
